title_zh: 单一形状 UI 变形循环
changes_from_source: 公开模板改写，补充固定 8 状态和原创音乐。
checks: 鼠标动作与状态变化对应
brief_en: Read states.json. Create a 16-second seamless loop in which ONE persistent shell morphs through the eight UI states in order. A visible cursor motivates clicks and drags. The shell must preserve spatial continuity; transition internal content without hard-cutting the shell. Use beat.wav and align major changes to its 120 BPM pulse. Return to the initial visual state at the loop boundary.
brief_zh: 读取 states.json，制作 16 秒无缝循环。同一个外壳按顺序变成 8 种 UI，鼠标通过点击和拖拽触发变化。外壳保持空间连续，内部内容可以过渡切换。使用 120 BPM 的 beat.wav，让主要变化贴合节拍，结尾回到开头状态。
